name: Blender 3D
description: Headless Blender 3D modeling on this desktop: a blender-team worker pipeline (model, materials+lighting in parallel, qa) drives a live Blender through the blender MCP tools; QA is a deterministic bmesh pass judged by the Clef decision model (escalating to an LLM qa worker when unsure), exporting .glb/.stl with rendered previews into the workspace.
author: shpaw415

skills.name: blender
skills.description: Local 3D modeling with Blender on this desktop. Use when the user asks for a real 3D model, a product visual, a printable part, materials or lighting beyond procedural gpio-3d parts, or any Blender scene work. Covers the blender-team worker pipeline (the only path that has the blender MCP tools) and quick headless bpy one-offs.
skills.body:
# Blender on this desktop

A headless Blender runs on 127.0.0.1:9876 with the blender-mcp addon socket
server. You (the chat agent) do NOT have the blender MCP tools — only
`blender-team` workers do. Never launch a second Blender instance and never
open the scene file in another instance: the live scene exists only in the
running process.

## Team pipeline (default path)

```sh
blender-team "a ceramic owl figurine, 80mm tall, printable" -o /home/agent/workspace/owl.glb
```

- The orchestrator runs role workers in order: `model` → `materials` →
  `lighting` → `qa`. Materials and lighting run in PARALLEL by default (they
touch disjoint parts of the scene); `--serial` forces the old sequential
  order. Each worker is an opencode session driving the live scene through
  the blender MCP tools (`get_scene_info`, `execute_code`, …).
- QA is cheap and deterministic first: the orchestrator snapshots the scene,
  runs a headless bmesh report plus two 16-sample JPEG previews plus the
  export in one `blender --background` process (`qa_checks.py`), and the
  Clef decision model (Cloudflare Workers AI) judges the renders against the
  goal. Judge pass p >= 0.7 passes; p < 0.3 fails into fix rounds; the band
  between escalates to the legacy LLM `qa` worker. Fix rounds are re-checked
  by the same cheap pass (~10 s), not by another LLM session. The dashboard
  config `qa_judge` (on/off) turns the judge off (config key in
  Plugins → blender → settings); without Cloudflare credentials the judge is
  skipped and the legacy qa worker runs.
- `--auto-roles` routes the goal with clef-flash first (printable part →
  model+qa only; fast visual → no lighting stage). Off by default.
- `--timeout 40` sets the per-worker minute budget (default 30 — raise it
  for hard organic models). `--out path.glb` (or `.stl`) sets the export
  target. `--roles model,materials,qa` picks a shorter pipeline manually.
- `--resume` continues on the live scene from an earlier pipeline (after a
  failed or timed-out run) instead of assuming a factory-startup scene;
  pair it with `--roles` to rerun only the stages that are still missing.
  A retried stage is told the scene may hold partial work, so a timeout
  costs progress only when the work was unusable.
- Each worker saves the scene to a `blender-team-<ts>/scene.blend` under the
  workspace and renders `preview-<role>.png` there; the qa stage writes
  `preview-qa.jpg` / `preview-qa-2.jpg` at reduced samples. Read those to
  review a stage.
- The CLI prints one `[blender-team]` line per stage. Surface the final model
  path and previews; do not paste the log.
- A scene lock serializes runs. If it says another run holds the lock, wait.
  Do not drive Blender yourself while a team runs.

## Quick headless one-offs (no MCP needed)

For a small deterministic edit (unit conversion, export, mesh stats), skip
the team and run bpy directly:

```sh
blender --background /home/agent/workspace/model.glb --python-expr "import bpy; print(len(bpy.data.objects))"
blender --background --python /tmp/script.py
```

Prefer `blender-team` when the goal needs modeling judgment, materials,
lighting, or iteration.

## Deliverables

- Save exports and previews under `/home/agent/workspace`.
- Embed the final model: `![description](/home/agent/workspace/name.glb)` —
  the chat renders an interactive 3D viewer for `.glb`/`.gltf`. Embed
  `preview-qa.png` as an image when it shows the result well.
- For AI-generated meshes from a provider (Meshy, Tripo, …) use `gen-3d`
  instead; Blender is for local, controllable, printable work.

## Service toggle

The plugin's `enabled` setting controls the Blender service: set it to `off`
on the dashboard (Plugins page -> blender -> settings) and the supervisor
stops Blender within seconds; set it back to `on` (or anything else) and it
restarts.

## Troubleshooting

- `Blender is not reachable on 127.0.0.1:9876` — check
  `~/.open-bot/blender.log`; the supervisor restarts crashed instances in a
  few seconds, so retry once after a pause.
- `the blender plugin service is set to off` — turn it back on in the
  dashboard (Plugins page -> blender -> settings) and tell the user.
- `another blender-team run holds the scene lock` — wait, or remove
  `~/.open-bot/blender-team.lock` only if no run is actually going.

commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends blender xauth python3-numpy
V=/home/agent/.open-bot/plugin-blender; test -x $V/venv/bin/blender-mcp || { python3 -m venv $V/venv && $V/venv/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir blender-mcp; }
V=/home/agent/.open-bot/plugin-blender; test -d $V/requests || python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --no-binary=:all: --target $V/requests requests

V=/home/agent/.open-bot/plugin-blender; mkdir -p $V; ln -sf /usr/local/bin/ob-plugin-blender-blender-serve.py $V/blender-serve.py; ln -sf /usr/local/bin/ob-plugin-blender-addon.py $V/addon.py; chmod -R a+rX $V

blender-worker.description: Blender pipeline worker. Drives the live Blender through the blender MCP tools for one stage assigned by the blender-team orchestrator.
blender-worker.prompt: You are a Blender pipeline worker. The blender-team orchestrator assigned you exactly one stage. Drive the live Blender instance only through the blender MCP tools (get_scene_info, get_object_info, execute_blender_code). Do not launch Blender processes and do not open a second instance. Stay on your stage. When the task asks for it, end your reply with exactly one line starting with RESULT:.
